articles.title: Anthropic被控未經許可 使用貓王歌曲訓練AI模型
key_points: Authentic Brands, the company that holds the rights to Elvis Presley's music, has sued Anthropic for using his songs to train the AI model Claude without permission.
The lawsuit claims that 274 of Elvis's songs were used, and the company is seeking $15 million per song in damages.
This is one of the first major legal challenges against an AI developer by a celebrity's estate, and the outcome could set a precedent for how AI companies use existing music libraries.
Spotify has removed around 50 million AI-generated songs from its recommendations in the past year due to concerns about low-quality AI-generated music.
articles.attention_reason: Anthropic faces legal action over unauthorized use of Elvis Presley's songs to train AI models.
